item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 25/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over Guangdong in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers and thunderstorms. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers over the coast of southern China midweek this week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to affect the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. There will still be showers over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will move in the general direction of the vicinity of western Japan in the next couple of days.
